decisions.reason: As a visible 2018 launch later promoted on the home page, this optical spectrum connectivity service fits the firm's stated move toward high-bandwidth software-defined infrastructure, so sunk investment and public commitment make management likely to persist with it.

Although less visibly promoted than Product C, the voice number ordering portal still builds on the core offer and supports the firm's push toward real-time provisioning, so escalation of commitment makes management somewhat more likely to keep than to drop it.
